    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":7,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":8,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":9,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":10,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":11,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":12,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":13,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":14,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":15,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":16,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":17,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":18,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":19,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":20,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":21,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":22,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":23,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":24,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":1,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":2,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":3,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":4,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

$(function(){
    
//$(".mode_btn").on('click', '.mode_btn_left', function(){
$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_left").live('click',  function(e){
    var style = $(this).attr('style_css');
//    var style = 2;
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');
//    alert(hypen_pos);
    if(hypen_pos>0){
        var new_url_head = url.substring(0, parseInt(hypen_pos)-1);
//        alert(new_url_head);
        var new_url_tail = url.substring(hypen_pos);
//        alert(new_url_tail);
        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;
//        alert(new_url);   
    }else{
        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url;
    e.preventDefault();
});

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":5,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

});

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":6,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":7,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":9,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":10,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":11,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":12,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":13,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":14,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":15,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":16,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":17,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":18,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

                <script type="text/javascript">
$(function(){
    
//$(".mode_btn").on('click', '.mode_btn_left', function(){
$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_left").live('click',  function(e){
    var style = $(this).attr('style_css');
//    var style = 2;
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');
//    alert(hypen_pos);
    if(hypen_pos>0){
        var new_url_head = url.substring(0, parseInt(hypen_pos)-1);
//        alert(new_url_head);
        var new_url_tail = url.substring(hypen_pos);
//        alert(new_url_tail);
        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;
//        alert(new_url);   
    }else{
        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url;
    e.preventDefault();
});

$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_right").live('click', function(e){

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":19,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":20,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

});

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":21,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

                <script type="text/javascript">
$(function(){
    
//$(".mode_btn").on('click', '.mode_btn_left', function(){
$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_left").live('click',  function(e){
    var style = $(this).attr('style_css');
//    var style = 2;
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');
//    alert(hypen_pos);
    if(hypen_pos>0){
        var new_url_head = url.substring(0, parseInt(hypen_pos)-1);
//        alert(new_url_head);
        var new_url_tail = url.substring(hypen_pos);
//        alert(new_url_tail);
        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;
//        alert(new_url);   
    }else{
        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url;
    e.preventDefault();
});

$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_right").live('click', function(e){

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":22,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');

    if(hypen_pos>0){

        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;

        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url;
    e.preventDefault();
});

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":23,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

                <script type="text/javascript">
$(function(){
    
//$(".mode_btn").on('click', '.mode_btn_left', function(){
$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_left").live('click',  function(e){
    var style = $(this).attr('style_css');
//    var style = 2;
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');
//    alert(hypen_pos);
    if(hypen_pos>0){
        var new_url_head = url.substring(0, parseInt(hypen_pos)-1);
//        alert(new_url_head);
        var new_url_tail = url.substring(hypen_pos);
//        alert(new_url_tail);
        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;
//        alert(new_url);   
    }else{
        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url;
    e.preventDefault();
});

$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_right").live('click', function(e){
    var style = $(this).attr('style_css');
//    alert(style);
//    var style = 2;
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');
//    alert(hypen_pos);
    if(hypen_pos>0){
        var new_url_head = url.substring(0, parseInt(hypen_pos)-1);
//        alert(new_url_head);
        var new_url_tail = url.substring(hypen_pos);
//        alert(new_url_tail);
        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;
//        alert(new_url);   
    }else{
        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url; 
    e.preventDefault();
});

})    
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":24,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":1,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":2,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":3,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){

        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":4,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":5,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    e.preventDefault();
});

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":6,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

                <script type="text/javascript">
$(function(){
    
//$(".mode_btn").on('click', '.mode_btn_left', function(){
$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_left").live('click',  function(e){
    var style = $(this).attr('style_css');
//    var style = 2;
    var url = window.location.href;
    var hypen_pos = url.lastIndexOf('-');
//    alert(hypen_pos);
    if(hypen_pos>0){
        var new_url_head = url.substring(0, parseInt(hypen_pos)-1);
//        alert(new_url_head);
        var new_url_tail = url.substring(hypen_pos);
//        alert(new_url_tail);
        var new_url = new_url_head+style+new_url_tail;
//        alert(new_url);   
    }else{
        var new_url = url.replace(/(\/$)/g,"")+'/'+style+'-1';
//        alert(new_url);         
    }
    window.location.href = new_url;
    e.preventDefault();
});

$(".mode_btn span .mode_btn_right").live('click', function(e){

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":7,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":8,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":9,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":10,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    $(document).ready(function(){
        var navs =$('#sortRanking').find('.side_nav');
        var params = {"ranking_list":"fivestars","cat_path":"01.00.00.00.00.00","page":11,"page_size":20,"type":"recent30","year":0,"month":0,"range":0,"style":1,"debug":""};
        navs.click(function(){
            var aNav = $(this)
            var cat3 = aNav.next();
            if($.trim(cat3.html()) == ''){
                params.cat_path_clicked = aNav.attr("category_path");
                $.ajax({
                    url: "/books/category",
                    type: "post",
                    contentType: "application/json",
                    data: JSON.stringify(params),
                    success: function(html){
                        cat3.html(html);
                        cat3.slideToggle();
                        aNav.toggleClass("hover");
                    }
                });
            }else{
                cat3.slideToggle();
                aNav.toggleClass("hover");
            }

        });

        var cat_path2_prefix = "01.00.00.00.00.00".substr(0,5);

        navs.each(function(){
            var aNav = $(this);
            if(aNav.attr("category_path").substr(0,5) == cat_path2_prefix){
                aNav.trigger('click');
                return false;
            }
        });
    });
</script>
